name: number_partitioning_k3_n20_seed19698__v12_nh
prompt:
Partition the integers {1, 2, ..., 20} into 3 disjoint subsets, each summing to the same value 70. (The total sum is 20*(20+1)/2 = 210, so the target is 210/3 = 70.) NP-hard partition problem.

Return a flat list of 20 integers in {0, ..., 2} where the i-th entry (0-indexed) gives the subset assignment of integer i+1. State "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such partition exists.
